notes: S2-FIX3 F79 (decision 2026-11-16 #1; §9.4, §9.5, §11.3): key-lifecycle/mutual-revocation-order-a with the manifest's created_at moved to T9, after both revocations (effective T2). §9.4 collects only valid revocations: by the §9.5 order the revocation of human-1 (signed by human-2, whose own revocation comes first) is invalid E_KEY_REVOKED and has no effect, so the manifest signature by human-1 passes §9.4 (container.errors []) and the records are reported as in the committed case. Counting every revocation record, valid or not, would stop the container with E_KEY_REVOKED at the manifest signature.
